/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.description: The 7 ft Curve Slide is the tallest version of our curved slide, in Play Red and Play Yellow with a steel ladder. From 7 ft the curve carries real speed, so this height is meant for older, confident children rather than toddlers. Schools with a separate senior play area often choose it, as do parks that want one slide to keep bigger children busy. The bend sends children out to one side, so plan the exit away from paths and swings. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts on this slide carry a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a layout drawing and we will mark the ladder, curve and landing zone on your site.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.spec_paragraph: A taller galvanised ladder carries children up to the curved bed. We grout or self-stand it after checking your ground. At 7 ft, the landing needs a generous impact-absorbing surface and the ladder needs a soft area below it too. Check handrails, steps and slide joints at each maintenance visit.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.description: Wrapping a 7 ft drop into a tight red spiral, this slide gives older children a fast, turning ride on a small footprint. A steel ladder leads to the top, and the open spiral lets children see where they are going as they go round. It suits primary and middle school grounds, municipal parks and resort play areas where the users are bigger and want more thrill than a low slide gives. The spiral also looks striking from a distance, which helps a park or society play area stand out. Our 3-year warranty applies to the galvanised ladder and roto-moulded spiral. Send us your site details for a quote and layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.spec_paragraph: The ladder and centre support are galvanised steel and the spiral bed is a weather-proof moulding. Installation is by grouting or a self-standing base. Mark the exit on your layout because it does not face the ladder. Keep a soft surface there and check the spiral joints and ladder fixings regularly.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.description: The 7 ft Spiral Tunnel Slide drops from a steel tower through a red and yellow enclosed tube that winds round on itself. From this height the ride is long and quick, and children cannot see out until they reach the exit. It is a big draw for older children in schools, parks and resorts, and the enclosed tube keeps them inside the slide all the way down. A spiral uses less ground than a straight tunnel of the same height. Steel and moulded parts are warranted for 3 years against manufacturing defects. Tell us your site size and we will plan the tower, tube and exit on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.spec_paragraph: A galvanised tower supports the moulded tunnel sections. Our installers set it self-standing or grouted. The exit must sit where an adult can watch it, with rubber flooring underneath. Clear leaves and rainwater from the tube, and check every joint between tunnel sections during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.description: Our 7 ft Straight Open Slide is a long, straight red and yellow chute with an open top, reached by a steel ladder. With no turns, the speed builds steadily all the way down, which older children enjoy. The straight line makes it easy to place along a boundary wall, and supervisors can see the child from top to bottom. For a school or park that already has a curved or spiral slide, this gives a simple contrast. The run-out at the bottom is longer than on our 3 ft model, so plan for it. The 3-year warranty covers this slide's galvanised steel and moulded bed. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.spec_paragraph: Galvanised steel forms the ladder and supports, and the open bed is moulded from weather-proof material. It can be grouted or set self-standing. Because children reach more speed from 7 ft, keep a long, soft landing zone at the foot and check the ladder handrails and bed edges regularly.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.description: The 7 ft Straight Tunnel Slide sends children down a straight red and yellow tube from a steel tower. It is the tallest straight tunnel in our range, so the ride is quick and direct. The closed tube suits schools and parks with older children who want a tunnel slide but do not need the turns of a spiral. A straight tunnel is also easier to line up along the edge of a play area. From outside, supervisors see the tower and exit but not the child inside, so position it where an adult can watch both ends. Our warranty gives 3 years on the galvanised tower and moulded tunnel. Send us your site plan for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.spec_paragraph: The tower is galvanised steel, and the tunnel is built from weather-proof moulded sections. It goes in self-standing or grouted, depending on your site. Lay rubber flooring at the exit, keep the tube clear of leaves and water, and check the section joints and tower steps at every maintenance visit.
flags: Name and URL are misspelt "Strtaight". Copy uses Straight Tunnel Slide.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.description: Sharp turns from a 7 ft start make this Zig Zag Slide one of the liveliest rides in our individual equipment range. Children climb a steel ladder and then switch direction several times in a red and yellow chute on the way down. The height and the turns together suit older children who find low slides too easy. The zig zag shape also means the slide covers its drop in less length than a straight slide, which helps on a narrow school or society plot. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts on the Zig Zag are covered for 3 years. Ask us for a layout drawing showing the slide and its exit.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-7f.spec_paragraph: This slide stands on a galvanised steel ladder and frame with a moulded zig zag bed. Our team grouts it or installs it self-standing. Keep an impact-absorbing surface under the full footprint, since the turns pass close to the ground on both sides, and check each bend for cracks during maintenance.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: The Aeroplane Spring Rider is a Forest Green aeroplane that rocks and bounces on a heavy spring. One child sits in the cockpit, holds the handles and rocks back and forth or side to side. Spring riders help small children practise balance and coordination, and they enjoy pretending to fly. It takes up little ground, so it slots into a nursery, play school or society toddler area beside larger pieces. The aeroplane shape also works well with a travel or sky theme. Roto-moulded bodies are covered by our 3-year warranty, and springs are covered for 1 year. Ask us how many spring riders your play area can take.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: The aeroplane body is roto-moulded, so it will not rust or rot in the rain, and it sits on a steel spring. We install spring riders self-standing or grouted to suit the ground. Leave space around the rider for its movement, use a soft surface underneath, and check the spring and its fixings regularly.
flags: No spec rows (age group, capacity, product area, safe play area) and no warranty line in the fact sheet. This applies to every spring rider in this group.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: Children sit on the back of a long Knight Blue alligator on this spring rider and rock it on its spring. The alligator's length gives a wide, stable seat, and a child can lean forward or back to make it move. Spring riders are often the first piece a toddler tries on their own, because the movement is gentle and they stay close to the ground. The Alligator Spring Rider fits a water or jungle theme in a society garden, play school or resort kids' area. Our warranty runs 3 years on roto-moulded parts and 1 year on the spring. Send us a photo of your toddler area for suggestions.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: A roto-moulded alligator body is fixed to a steel spring. It can be installed self-standing or by grouting. Keep the area around the alligator's head and tail clear, place it on rubber flooring, and check that the spring has not lost its bounce and that all bolts are tight.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: The Bike Spring Rider is shaped like a red motorbike, with a seat and handlebars, mounted on a spring. A child climbs on, grips the handlebars and rocks it as if riding. Children who are too young for a real cycle love the pretend ride, and it gives them practice in balance and holding on. The Play Red colour stands out in a toddler corner and pairs well with a road or traffic theme. It needs very little ground, so a play school or society garden can fit it alongside other riders. Our 3-year warranty covers its roto-moulded body, and the spring carries 1 year. Ask us for a quote on a set of riders.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: The bike body is roto-moulded and fixed to a steel spring. We set it up self-standing or grouted. Use an impact-absorbing surface under the rider, keep space around it for its rocking movement, and check the handlebars, spring and base bolts during routine maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: A Forest Green dinosaur sits on a spring in the Dino Spring Rider. Children climb on its back, hold on and bounce or rock, often roaring along as they go. Dinosaurs are a favourite theme with young children, so the Dino Rider is popular in play schools and society toddler areas. Like our other spring riders, it gives small children a gentle way to practise balance close to the ground. It pairs well with our Aeroplane Rider, which shares the same Forest Green colour, if you want a matching set. The roto-moulded dinosaur comes with a 3-year warranty, and the spring with 1 year. Ask us to add it to your layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: The dinosaur body is roto-moulded and does not rust in wet weather. Its spring is fixed to the ground by grouting or a self-standing base. Leave room around the rider for its movement, use rubber flooring underneath, and inspect the spring and handholds regularly.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: The Duck Spring Rider is a bright Play Yellow duck on a steel spring, with handles either side of its head and a footrest below. A small child sits on the duck's back and rocks or bounces it. Its rounded shape and cheerful colour make it a friendly first ride for toddlers in a play school, nursery or society garden. A duck also fits a pond or garden theme. Spring riders take up little space, so you can group the Duck Rider with two or three others in one corner. Roto-moulded parts are covered for 3 years and springs for 1 year. Share your site photos and we will suggest a spot for it.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: The duck body is roto-moulded and sits on a coiled steel spring with a footrest bar. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Place it on an impact-absorbing surface with space all round for its rocking, and check the spring, handles and base fixings during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: The Dumbo Spring Rider is one of our character spring riders, finished in Green. Like the others in the range, it carries one small child on a steel spring, and children rock or bounce it while holding on. Spring riders are simple, low and gentle, which makes them a safe-feeling first ride for toddlers. Societies and play schools often buy two or three different characters so that children can choose their favourite. If you are planning a toddler corner, the Dumbo Rider can sit beside our duck, horse or dinosaur riders. Its roto-moulded body has a 3-year warranty and the spring a 1-year warranty. Ask us for a photo and a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: Its body is roto-moulded and fixed to a steel spring. We install it self-standing or with grouting. Keep the ground around the rider clear and soft, check the spring for wear and the base bolts for tightness during maintenance, and replace a worn spring promptly.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: The Horse Spring Rider is a Play Orange horse with a handlebar, set on a spring. A child sits astride the horse, holds the handlebar and rocks it to and fro, much like a rocking horse. The horse is a classic shape that most children recognise, and it gives toddlers an easy introduction to balance play. It fits a play school, nursery or society garden, and its orange colour adds a warm contrast to green lawns. Because it takes up so little ground, you can place it near a toddler swing or small slide. Our warranty covers the roto-moulded horse for 3 years and the spring for 1 year. Ask us for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: The horse is roto-moulded and fixed to a steel spring, with a handlebar for grip. It is installed self-standing or grouted, depending on your base. Keep an impact-absorbing surface under the rider and check the handlebar, spring and base bolts at regular intervals.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.description: Shaped like a seahorse and finished in Lemon Yellow, this spring rider brings a sea theme to a toddler play area. A child sits on the seahorse, holds on and rocks it on its spring. The curled tail and upright head make it one of the more unusual characters in our spring rider range. It suits play schools, nurseries, resorts and society gardens that want something less common than a horse or duck. Spring riders keep small children close to the ground while they practise balance. The roto-moulded seahorse carries our 3-year warranty, and the spring is warranted for 1 year. Send us your site photos for a layout suggestion.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/spring-r.spec_paragraph: The seahorse body is roto-moulded and the spring is steel. Our installers fix it self-standing or grouted in. Leave clear space round the rider for its rocking movement, lay rubber flooring below, and check the spring and handholds as part of regular maintenance.
